channel.title: AI GridWatch — New Hampshire data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for New Hampshire, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Nottingham passes moratorium on data centers, over 90 percent vote in favor
Keene: data center moratorium — Under Review
item.description: City Council referred request to add/update land development code definitions for data centers, cryptocurrency mines and private detention facilities to Joint Planning Board/PLD Committee. PLD Committee voted Sep 10 to advance moratorium proposal to Planning Board for evaluation of need and scope; any moratorium limited to 1 year max

item.title: Bow: data center moratorium — Under Review
item.description: Planning Board voted unanimously for 1-year moratorium on data center construction after hyperscale proposal surfaced at former Merrimack Station coal plant site (350 MW FERC interconnection study). Town vote may still be required under RSA 674:23

item.title: Nottingham: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Voters ratified a 12-month moratorium on data center construction 1,335-143 at the Sep 8, 2026 special town election; Planning Board had adopted it 5-0 under RSA 674:23 on Jul 1. Ordinance allows the town time to study land use, environmental infrastructure and fiscal impacts; planning board chair has said permanent zoning may follow. End date of the 12-month term not stated in the sourced reporting

Canterbury: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Voters approved zoning amendment banning data centers in all zones, 322-63; Planning Board proposed marking 'Data Centers' as 'Not Allowed' in every zone

item.title: Rochester: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: City Council enacted ordinance prohibiting data centers in every zoning district except Recycling Industrial zone (conditional use permit required); Waste Management owns most land in that zone, making construction effectively impossible. Two hours of resident testimony at Aug 18 public hearing

item.title: New Hampshire (HB 1265): data center moratorium — Defeated
item.description: 1-year statewide moratorium on new data center construction plus legislative study committee; sponsored by Rep. Peter Schmidt (D-Dover); declared Inexpedient to Legislate by voice vote

item.title: New Hampshire (Ayotte): data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Governor Ayotte announced support for statewide moratorium lasting 'a period of years'; plans to include moratorium in FY2028-2029 state budget. SB 439 (industry preemption) was tabled 304-11 by the House. Two Democratic LSRs also filed for 24-month moratorium in 2027 session
